reason: The done/push/shrink/drop prompt is a nice idea, but nothing here says keyboard shortcuts, integrations or automations, and that's the bar before I move off Apple Notes plus Google Calendar. I've churned out of Sunsama and Motion already, so I'd poke at the free plan maybe, but I'm not paying $12 for another planner on faith.
objection: It wants me to move notes, contacts and email into one more app, but it doesn't say whether it syncs both ways with my Google Calendar, has a command palette, or connects to Slack and Linear. If it doesn't, it's a prettier version of what Google Calendar does for free.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a keyboard-first demo with two-way Google Calendar sync and integrations with the tools my company already uses, where the end-of-block reflow takes one shortcut instead of clicks.
